candidates.reason: Directly exercises scrapy.utils.deprecate warning machinery (create_deprecated_class, warn_on_subclassed) with warnings.catch_warnings()/pytest.warns(); it is the module whose behavior changes most when pytest starts turning every unhandled warning into an error.

Carries eight broad @pytest.mark.filterwarnings("ignore::scrapy.exceptions.ScrapyDeprecationWarning") markers for the crawler-less HttpCompressionMiddleware deprecation (scrapy/downloadermiddlewares/httpcompression.py:50); those broad ignores must be narrowed/replaced under an error-warnings policy.

Class-level ignore::ScrapyDeprecationWarning markers cover the deprecated send_catch_log_deferred signal API, an example of broad suppression the new policy is meant to replace with explicit expectations.
Class-level ignore::ScrapyDeprecationWarning marker for the deprecated maybeDeferred/mustbe_deferred code paths in scrapy/utils/defer.py, which currently relies on a blanket suppression.

Whole-class ignore::ScrapyDeprecationWarning for FormRequest.from_response(), plus scoped warnings.simplefilter("error", ScrapyDeprecationWarning) assertions; the global error policy makes both halves load-bearing.
Method- and class-level ignore markers for the deprecated CaselessDict.getdefault()/setdefault() behavior; these suppressions would be reworked when warnings become errors.

Class-level ignore::scrapy.exceptions.ScrapyDeprecationWarning on the non-async engine download tests (calls the deprecated ExecutionEngine.download / download_request paths in scrapy/core/engine.py).

Per-test @pytest.mark.filterwarnings("ignore::scrapy.exceptions.ScrapyDeprecationWarning") around deprecated spider-attribute behavior (download_maxsize on the spider class, scrapy/utils/sitemap.py warnings).

Combines RuntimeWarning from RefererMiddleware._load_policy (scrapy/spidermiddlewares/referer.py:433) with ScrapyDeprecationWarning for the resp_or_url rename, and asserts the absence of a specific warning using a scoped "error" filter that must keep working under global warnings-as-errors.
Module-level pytestmark ignores the scrapy.mail deprecation for every test in the file, and the module import itself is deprecation-triggering; import-time and per-test warnings both become errors.
Wraps the deprecated scrapy.extensions.statsmailer and scrapy.mail imports in warnings.catch_warnings()/filterwarnings; those import-time suppressions are exactly what a global error filter breaks.

Asserts both the presence (pytest.warns) and absence (warnings.simplefilter("error", ScrapyDeprecationWarning)) of the deprecated logformatter msg/args interpolation warning emitted from scrapy/utils/log.py:271.

Silences the deprecated CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_PER_IP warning inside a catch_warnings/filterwarnings block while asserting the resulting ValueError; the surrounding policy change determines whether that scoping is still required.

Contains scoped filters for Twisted CertificateOptions/abortConnection DeprecationWarnings and several pytest.warns assertions for the deprecated DOWNLOADER_CLIENT_TLS_METHOD setting, OpenSSL ciphers and TLS method helpers.
Asserts ScrapyDeprecationWarning from the deprecated scrapy.utils.ssl helpers (scrapy/utils/ssl.py:126-160) using pytest.warns and catch_warnings blocks.
Parametrized pytest.mark.filterwarnings("ignore::scrapy.exceptions.ScrapyDeprecationWarning") markers for the deprecated DeferredPipeline spider argument (scrapy/pipelines/__init__.py warnings).
Exercises the deprecated media/file pipeline code paths that warn from scrapy/pipelines/files.py:479/778 and scrapy/pipelines/media.py, and uses warning handling around them.
Covers MediaPipeline deprecations that emit ScrapyDeprecationWarning from scrapy/pipelines/media.py:96/237, a common source of unhandled warnings in the suite.
Asserts the deprecated BaseDupeFilter.log() ScrapyDeprecationWarning with pytest.warns, so it must remain an explicit expectation rather than an accidental warning.
Asserts the ScrapyDeprecationWarning for passing str xmltext to Sitemap (scrapy/utils/sitemap.py:31), a deprecated-usage test that interacts with the new global error filter.
Asserts the ScrapyDeprecationWarning emitted when a middleware manager is built without a crawler (scrapy/middleware.py:44/121) using pytest.warns.

Asserts both the ScrapyCommand.help() deprecation warning and the absence of the override warning using pytest.warns/recwarn (scrapy/commands/__init__.py:53-90); it is the canonical expected-warning test for the command layer.
Carries an ignore filter for the CPython forkpty DeprecationWarning ("is multi-threaded, use of forkpty"), arguably the one interpreter-level exception the policy keeps.
Dedicated deprecation test class covering the deprecated CRAWLSPIDER_FOLLOW_LINKS setting and CrawlSpider rule handling, which emits ScrapyDeprecationWarning from scrapy/spiders/crawl.py.

Asserts the UserWarning emitted by scrapy/utils/misc.py:308 when a generator callback returns a value, and asserts it is not emitted when the setting is disabled; a first-party warning that must stay intentional under warnings-as-errors.

Shared base defining parametrized filters for the ssl.TLSVersion.TLSv1 DeprecationWarning and the cryptography X.509 DeprecationWarning; it propagates to tests/test_downloader_handler_*.py, so any policy change must be reflected here first.
